jobs.title: Environmental Scientist 1
jobs.description: Bachelor's in environmental science or related field required. Experience with environmental sampling, regulatory compliance, inspections, data management, Microsoft Office and ArcGIS. Valid CA driver's license and ability to lift 50 lbs.

jobs.title: ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENTIST 3
jobs.description: Bachelor's in physical/natural/life sciences or engineering plus 3 years environmental experience, or HS plus 5 years experience, or equivalent; experience with environmental monitoring, data analysis, reporting, GIS, and field sampling.

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist
jobs.description: Bachelors in environmental or related field, 5+ years water quality experience with surface/groundwater sampling, field instrumentation use, data QA/QC, technical writing, and ability to perform remote fieldwork in Hawaiʻi.

jobs.title: Natural Resources Specialist
jobs.description: Bachelor's in biological sciences/agriculture/natural resource management/chemistry or related; 1 year specialized experience advising pest control, ensuring compliance, and coordinating IPM with agencies; U.S. citizenship required.

jobs.title: Natural Resources Specialist
jobs.description: Associate's degree in related field and 3 years program management experience required (or equivalent). Must be able to drive throughout Deschutes County; grant/contract administration, GIS, CWPPs, and natural resource management experience preferred.

jobs.title: Natural Resources Specialist 2
jobs.description: Two years of college coursework in natural sciences or related field, ≥6 months field or research experience, valid Ohio driver’s license, outdoor field skills (species ID, navigation), ability to walk up to 5 miles and lift 40 lbs.

jobs.title: Natural Resources Program Coordinator - Brewster, NY
jobs.description: Bachelor's degree (or Associate + 2 years experience), valid NYS driver license, ability to travel, experience delivering natural resources programs, Microsoft Office and GIS proficiency, ability to work flexible hours and manage volunteers.

jobs.title: Natural Resources Specialist (Environmental Field Inspector-Haz-Mat/Storage Tanks)
jobs.location: Plantation or Fort Lauderdale or Broward County
jobs.description: Bachelor's in chemistry, geology, biology, environmental science or related; 6 months natural resource protection experience; valid Florida Class E driver license; knowledge of hazardous materials/storage tank inspections; computer and communication skills.

jobs.title: Natural Resources Field Technician
jobs.description: 2+ years ecological field experience or college degree in related field; experience with species ID, surveys, GPS/ArcGIS, able to work outdoors in remote locations, valid driver’s license required.

jobs.title: Conservation GIS Analyst
jobs.description: Bachelor's degree + 2 years experience or a Master's; strong multi-platform GIS skills (ESRI ArcGIS), spatial analysis, species/ecosystem modeling (Maxent, Random Forest), scripting (Python or R), Google Earth Engine, SQL, reproducible workflows, and strong communication.

jobs.title: Associate GIS Consultant
jobs.description: BA/BS in GIS or Geography, 2+ years professional GIS experience, advanced ArcGIS Pro/Online/Enterprise skills, Python and Arcade proficiency, spatial analysis and geodatabase experience (PostgreSQL/PostGIS or SQL Server).

jobs.title: GIS Consultant/Project Manager
jobs.location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description: Bachelor's (5+ yrs exp) or Master's (3+ yrs exp) in a related field; experience implementing GIS solutions, managing small technical teams, familiarity with Agile Scrum and Waterfall, strong communication and analytical skills, willing to undergo government background investigation.

jobs.title: Project GIS Specialist
jobs.description: Bachelor's in a related field, 5+ years professional GIS experience, strong ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online skills, experience with Field Maps/Survey123, spatial analysis, QA/QC, and environmental consulting experience.

jobs.title: Consultant, Environmental Engineer / Scientist / Geologist
jobs.description: Bachelor's in a related field or equivalent experience, 2+ years in environmental consulting, NJ regs knowledge, 40-hour HAZWOPER + 8-hour refresher, valid driver's license, ability to lift 40 lbs, MS Office proficiency, strong communication, field work required. No immigration sponsorship.

jobs.title: Environmental Consultant – Senior Level (Hybrid)
jobs.description: 15+ years in environmental permitting, review, and compliance; bachelor’s degree in environmental science or related field; strong regulatory expertise (Michigan/federal); valid driver’s license; authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

new_jobs.title: GIS Analyst
new_jobs.description: U.S. citizen able to pass background check; associate degree or technical training in underground utility mapping; 1–2 years GIS/GPS field collection; able to interpret as-built drawings; ability to open manholes; travel up to two weeks.

new_jobs.title: Environmental Scientist

new_jobs.title: Senior Geologist
